All projects10 AI6 ML & search1 Full-stack5 Backend7 10 of 10 projects 01 / 2026 AI · Backend Walkthru AI agent platform A LangGraph browser agent that drives real user journeys in your own Chrome, backed by a stateless FastAPI API, a durable Postgres job queue, 18 deterministic scanners and a 24-tool remote MCP server. 711 API tests. Python / FastAPI / LangGraph / LangSmith / PostgreSQL Read case study ↗Live site ↗ 02 / 2026 Full-stack · Backend TripVerse Agentic planner Two LangGraph planning graphs writing into one normalized trip document. Budget, routing cost and day capacity are deterministic code; models only propose. Streamed over FastAPI with a Groq → Groq → Gemini fallback chain and 188 backend tests. LangGraph / FastAPI / PostgreSQL / SQLAlchemy / asyncpg Read case study ↗Live site ↗ 03 / 2026 AI SkyGuide AI Distributed realtime system React, an Express 5 gateway and a private FastAPI astronomy engine. Vectorised scoring of 13,311 deep-sky objects for your exact telescope and sky, and live telescope guidance over a 20 Hz WebSocket stream with a hysteresis state machine. FastAPI / Astropy / Skyfield / NumPy / Express 5 Read case study ↗Live site ↗ 04 / 2026 AI · ML & search Neuron Multimodal retrieval & RAG Text, image and audio fused into one CLIP query vector, re-ranked by a weighted blend of BM25, dense and visual similarity, with location-aware RAG that cites the exact page and line — and degrades gracefully when a model is missing. Python / FastAPI / CLIP / Whisper / BLIP Read case study ↗ 05 / 2026 AI · Full-stack · Backend Claimwise AI-assisted claims workflow A health insurance claims prototype that reads documents, prepares a reviewable claim pack, and tracks the outcome. Gemini extracts facts; FastAPI and LangGraph keep approvals, mock submissions, and payment checks tied to the case. React / Vite / Python / FastAPI / LangGraph Read case study ↗Live site ↗ 06 / 2025 Full-stack · Backend Yap Chat Realtime messaging & WebRTC Room-scoped realtime chat and 8-way peer-to-peer video: JWT-verified Socket.IO identity, a glare-free WebRTC mesh where media never touches the server, and 35/35 tests passing against a live server. Node.js / Express 5 / Socket.IO / WebRTC / MongoDB Read case study ↗Live site ↗ 07 / 2026 AI · Full-stack · Backend Scribb Creative platform & journal AI A deployed sketchbook and journal platform with tactile page turns, public creator profiles and a private-journal AI companion. React, Express and FastAPI share a Postgres data model with versioned saves and owner-scoped retrieval. React / TypeScript / Express / PostgreSQL / Neon / Python Read case study ↗Live site ↗ 08 / 2026 AI · Backend KOE (声) Voice agent & workspace Gemini Live voice calls, chat and voice notes over one FastAPI tool registry. GitHub, Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Notion workflows share a persisted approval gate; an exclusive audio coordinator keeps Spotify and conversations from competing. Python / FastAPI / Gemini Live / PostgreSQL / Neon / React Read case study ↗Live site ↗ 09 / 2026 Backend Shiori Go server hardening A security-hardened fork of a Go/Echo media server: audited ~300 routes, closed a critical unauthenticated network exposure, added per-IP rate limiting, lockout and a strict CSP, and runs sandboxed JavaScript providers with automatic failover. 23/23 attack probes pass.
